title: Champion strength / mobilization

questions.text: Do we have a real champion who has influence and motivation to help move the deal internally?

criteria.guide: Is a champion identified in the state?
Does evidence show the champion can move others (approvals, introductions)?
Is the champion responsive and active recently, or quiet/weakening?

criteria.text: evidence they are helping navigate internally
criteria.guide: Quotes showing the champion introduces people, explains the process or pushes internally.

har97.text: * evidence they are helping navigate internally

criteria.guide: Does the deal depend on the champion alone where other stakeholders are needed?

criteria.text: whether the action strengthens or weakens them
criteria.guide: Does this action make the champion more effective internally, or undercut them?

har97.text: * whether the action strengthens or weakens them

criteria.guide: If the champion explicitly handed ownership to someone, the new owner carries the step.

known_exceptions: Champion explicitly delegated ownership or left the process.
principles: Do not reduce this to “keep the champion CC’d.”

diagnostics.name: weak_champion
diagnostics.when: the champion lacks influence, activity or motivation

diagnostics.name: over_reliant_on_champion
diagnostics.when: the deal depends on the champion alone
